The two brush heads can be switched at will to meet different tooth brushing needs.Specification:Item Type: U-Shaped Automatic ToothbrushHost Power: 2WRated Charging Input: 5V/1ACharging Time: About 2 hoursLithium Battery: 450mAh (included)Instructions:Step 1: Insert the brush head carefully into the output shaft and fix it.Step 2: Squeeze the toothpaste into the toothbrush head. Liquid toothpaste or ordinary toothpaste can be used. Ordinary toothpaste must be wetted with braces before putting it in the mouthStep 3: Gently place the upper and lower teeth on the alveolar, then press the switch, shake the toothbrush left and right with your hands to touch the teeth on both sides.Step 4: Complete the tooth cleaning, clean the toothbrush, and dry it.
